verdict.rationale: Apify supports working across many items. Actor runs take lists of inputs such as startUrls with crawl limits, multiple tasks with different inputs can be created and run repeatedly, and results from several runs can be merged into one dataset and exported to CSV, JSON or XLSX. CLI shell scripting and webhook chaining also allow batch orchestration. However, the evidence never shows a dedicated bulk or batch API, such as batch-updating or deleting many records or starting many runs in one call. Missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk endpoints or commands, documented bulk mutation of items or resources, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
